sightings.title: handle CAP-40 signed-payload signers in ingestion
SAC-created trustlines produce no trustline state change (CAP-0073)
AddressBytea truncates muxed and signed-payload addresses (Soroban participant path)
derive Soroban participants from executed meta, not the auth tree (unbounded recursion over authorization trees)

sightings_corpus.why: The commits before these fixes use go-stellar-sdk 0.7.3, which predates protocol 29 and can't decode a protocol 29 ledger header (StellarValueType 3). They ran against protocol 28 networks, so the sightings replay a protocol 28 copy of the same scenarios, generated deterministically by the same pinned stellar-core: node kit/capture/generate.mjs --protocol 28 --out .cache/corpus-p28
